name: paseto-wasm
description: A PASETO implementation in Rust with WebAssembly (WASM) bindings

scripts.build:wasm: rimraf pkg && pnpm run build:wasm:web && pnpm run build:wasm:node && pnpm run build:wasm:web:v3 && pnpm run build:wasm:node:v3 && pnpm run build:wasm:node:v3:fiat-backend && pnpm run build:wasm:memory64 && pnpm run build:wasm:memory64:node && pnpm run build:wasm:memory64:v3
scripts.build:wasm:web:v3: mkdirp pkg/v3 && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/v3 --features v3 --no-default-features
scripts.build:wasm:node: mkdirp pkg/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/cjs && shx mv pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm:node:v3: mkdirp pkg/v3/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/v3/cjs --features v3 --no-default-features && shx mv pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/v3/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm:node:v3:fiat-backend: mkdirp pkg/v3-fiat/cjs && cross-env RUSTFLAGS="--cfg p384_backend=\"fiat\"" wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/v3-fiat/cjs --features v3 --no-default-features && shx mv pkg/v3-fiat/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/v3-fiat/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm:web:v5: mkdirp pkg/v5 && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/v5 --features v5 --no-default-features
scripts.build:wasm:node:v5: mkdirp pkg/v5/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/v5/cjs --features v5 --no-default-features && shx mv pkg/v5/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/v5/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.build:wasm:web:v6: mkdirp pkg/v6 && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg/v6 --features v6 --no-default-features
scripts.build:wasm:node:v6: mkdirp pkg/v6/cjs && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg/v6/cjs --features v6 --no-default-features && shx mv pkg/v6/cjs/paseto_wasm.js pkg/v6/cjs/paseto_wasm.cjs
scripts.test: pnpm run test:wasm:node && pnpm run test:wasm:web:v3
scripts.test:wasm:node: node tests/node_test.cjs && node test-cross-impl.mjs && node test-node.mjs && node test-vectors.mjs
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run test:wasm:node && pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run removeDirsBeforePrepublish

author: Achmad Kurnianto
